calculate_metrics: calculate recommendation metrics including recall and NDCG at various k values for predictions versus labels
calculate_pos_index: calculate the positive index tensor by matching predictions against ground truth labels with EOS token handling
recall_at_k: compute recall at k by counting how many of the top k predictions match the ground truth label
ndcg_at_k: compute normalized discounted cumulative gain at k using logarithmic discounting of ranked predictions
init_evaluator: initialize an Evaluator with a config dict specifying metrics and topk values plus a tokenizer object
